Game Overview

Pumpkin Stick is a halloween title where help Jack the Pumpkin navigate a thrilling world by stretching sticks just right to cross platforms. Misjudge the length, and Jack tumbles, so precision is everything. With simple controls and engaging challenges, "Pumpkin Stick" offers a delightful test of skill for all ages. Can you master the balance?
